name: unreal
description: Observe, diagnose, and safely operate an Unreal Engine project's build/cook/package pipeline and editor automation. A read-first, gamedev-focused Claude Code agent with an engine/project version doctor, cook-log diagnosis, gated BuildCookRun/UBT builds, first-party editor scripting, and runtime performance profiling (Unreal Insights, stat/obj triage, GC and Nanite heuristics).
